name: plugin.kimi_transcript
description: Isomorphic 4-layer transcript data engine with granularity-gated telemetry filtering and 4-tier DI scope hierarchy introspection.

entrypoints.name: kimi_transcript_project
entrypoints.description: Projects raw or normalized agent execution event frames at client-requested granularity (off, turn, block, delta) with cursor pagination.

parameters.name: frames
parameters.description: List of raw or normalized event frames to filter and project

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Granularity filter level: 'off' (empty), 'turn' (turn boundaries only), 'block' (tool blocks and turns), or 'delta' (full token stream)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of frames to return in page (default: 100)

entrypoints.name: kimi_scope_inspect
entrypoints.description: Introspects the active ServiceContext parent-child hierarchy and annotates each context level with 4-tier scope roles (APP, WORKSPACE, SESSION, AGENT).

parameters.name: depth_limit
parameters.description: Maximum scope hierarchy depth to inspect (default: 10)

parameters.name: include_services
parameters.description: Include list of registered service key names per scope (default: true)
